content:
[V|low] left of "Billing export" row | the selected row's name is obscured by a cursor/hover highlight pill covering the text rather than the full row.
[L|high] bottom half of window | roughly the lower two-thirds of the screen is a single unmanaged dead zone with no content after the footer line.
[L|med] Rows panel | the panel is a fixed narrow card floating at top-left instead of spanning the content width or aligning with the table above.
[S|med] Rows panel | "Rows (2)" heading, search input, and the "1"/"2" output lines have uneven internal spacing (large gap above search, cramped lines below).
[H|med] Rows panel | the raw row values "1" and "2" render as bare unstyled debug-like strings with no column headers or formatting.
[H|low] top-right header | "3 connectors" text competes visually with the New Connector button as an unaligned, floating label of similar weight.
[S|low] table action columns | refresh/Edit/Delete buttons are packed tightly together while the table columns above have wide uneven gaps, creating inconsistent rhythm.
[C|low] footer | the footer caption sits alone under a full-width divider floating in empty space rather than anchored at the page bottom.

TOTAL 8
